skill_name: Given a list of ingredients and processes, suggest an instruction to cook risotto.
workflow: In a large pan, heat the butter over medium heat and cook the onion until softened. Add the rice and cook for about 2 minutes until it is nutty and slightly toasted. Gradually add the chicken broth, stirring continually. Continue cooking and stirring for about 20 minutes until the risotto is creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste and stir in the Parmesan cheese.
